content: # Laws of UX: run Fitts's and Hick's law experiments in the browser and fit the models to your own data. fitts_example <- local({ set.seed(7) w <- rep(c(20, 40, 80), 6); d <- round(runif(18, 80, 520)) id <- log2(d / w + 1) list(d = d, w = w, t = round(180 + 140 * id + rnorm(18, 0, 45)), misses = 1) }) hick_example <- local({ set.seed(11) n <- rep(c(2, 4, 8, 16), 4) list(n = n, t = round(420 + 260 * log2(n + 1) + rnorm(16, 0, 90)), errors = 1) }) experiment_area <- function(kind, input_id, start_label) { div(class = "exp-area", `data-fitts` = if (kind == "fitts") input_id, `data-hick` = if (kind == "hick") input_id, `data-done` = tr("Done! Your results are below.", "¡Hecho! Tus resultados están debajo."), `data-target` = tr("Target", "Objetivo"), `data-find` = tr("Click:", "Pulsa:"), div(class = "d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2", tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn btn-primary btn-sm", `data-exp-start` = NA, start_label), span(class = "exp-status footnote", `aria-live` = "polite")), div(class = "exp-stage", p(class = "exp-done", tr("Press start when you are ready. Use a mouse or trackpad and go as fast as you can without errors.", "Pulsa empezar cuando estés listo. Usa un ratón o trackpad y ve lo más rápido que puedas sin cometer errores.")))) } laws_of_ux_ui <- function(id) { ns <- NS(id) lab_section(ns, objectives = c(tr("Measure how target size and distance affect pointing time (Fitts's law).", "Medir cómo afectan el tamaño y la distancia del objetivo al tiempo de apuntado (ley de Fitts)."), tr("Measure how the number of choices affects decision time (Hick's law).", "Medir cómo afecta el número de opciones al tiempo de decisión (ley de Hick)."), tr("Translate the models into design decisions.", "Traducir los modelos en decisiones de diseño.")), concept = tr("Some UX ‘laws’ are robust experimental findings. Fitts's law predicts that big, close targets are faster to hit; Hick's law predicts that decision time grows with the number of equally likely options, but only logarithmically.", "Algunas «leyes» de UX son hallazgos experimentales sólidos. La ley de Fitts predice que los objetivos grandes y cercanos se alcanzan antes; la de Hick, que el tiempo de decisión crece con el número de opciones igual de probables, pero solo de forma logarítmica."), activity = tagList( navset_underline( nav_panel(tr("Fitts's law", "Ley de Fitts"), div(class = "pt-3", p(tr("Click each green target as soon as it appears. There are 18 targets of three sizes at random distances.", "Pulsa cada objetivo verde en cuanto aparezca. Hay 18 objetivos de tres tamaños a distancias aleatorias.")), experiment_area("fitts", ns("fitts_data"), tr("Start Fitts experiment", "Empezar experimento de Fitts")), layout_columns(col_widths = c(7, 5), class = "mt-3", plotOutput(ns("fitts_plot"), height = "320px"), uiOutput(ns("fitts_model"))))), nav_panel(tr("Hick's law", "Ley de Hick"), div(class = "pt-3", p(tr("Find and click the city named at the top. The number of options changes between 2 and 16.", "Encuentra y pulsa la ciudad indicada arriba. El número de opciones cambia entre 2 y 16.")), experiment_area("hick", ns("hick_data"), tr("Start Hick experiment", "Empezar experimento de Hick")), layout_columns(col_widths = c(7, 5), class = "mt-3", plotOutput(ns("hick_plot"), height = "320px"), uiOutput(ns("hick_model")))))), p(class = "footnote mt-2", tr("Your timings stay in this browser session. ‘Load an example’ fills both experiments with simulated data.", "Tus tiempos se quedan en esta sesión del navegador. «Cargar un ejemplo» rellena ambos experimentos con datos simulados."))), reflection = tr("Where in a product you know would a bigger or closer target, or fewer choices, make a real difference? What would you trade off?", "¿En qué punto de un producto que conozcas marcaría la diferencia un objetivo más grande o más cercano, o menos opciones? ¿Qué sacrificarías?")) } laws_of_ux_server <- function(id) { moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) { fitts <- reactiveVal(NULL) hick <- reactiveVal(NULL) observeEvent(input$fitts_data, fitts(lapply(input$fitts_data[c("d", "w", "t", "misses")], unlist))) observeEvent(input$hick_data, hick(lapply(input$hick_data[c("n", "t", "errors")], unlist))) fitts_fit <- reactive({ f <- fitts(); req(f) df <- data.frame(id = log2(f$d / f$w + 1), t = f$t, w = f$w) df <- df[df$t < 5000, ] m <- lm(t ~ id, data = df) list(df = df, m = m, a = coef(m)[[1]], b = coef(m)[[2]], r2 = summary(m)$r.squared, tp = mean(df$id / (df$t / 1000)), misses = f$misses) }) hick_fit <- reactive({ h <- hick(); req(h) df <- data.frame(n = h$n, h = log2(h$n + 1), t = h$t) df <- df[df$t < 10000, ] m <- lm(t ~ h, data = df) list(df = df, m = m, a = coef(m)[[1]], b = coef(m)[[2]], r2 = summary(m)$r.squared, errors = h$errors) }) empty_plot <- function(msg) { ixd_par(); plot.new(); text(.5, .5, msg, col = "#5f665f") } output$fitts_plot <- renderPlot({ if (is.null(fitts())) return(empty_plot(tr("Run the experiment to see your data", "Haz el experimento para ver tus datos"))) f <- fitts_fit(); cols <- c(`20` = ixd_red, `40` = ixd_sand, `80` = ixd_green) ixd_par() plot(f$df$id, f$df$t, pch = 19, col = cols[as.character(f$df$w)], xlab = tr("Index of difficulty, ID = log2(D/W + 1) bits", "Índice de dificultad, ID = log2(D/W + 1) bits"), ylab = tr("Movement time (ms)", "Tiempo de movimiento (ms)")) abline(f$m, col = "#202522", lwd = 2) legend("topleft", legend = paste(c(20, 40, 80), "px"), pch = 19, col = cols, bty = "n", title = tr("Target width", "Ancho del objetivo"), cex = .85) }, res = 96) output$fitts_model <- renderUI({ if (is.null(fitts())) return(div(class = "panel-soft footnote", tr("The model MT = a + b · ID will be fitted to your clicks.", "El modelo MT = a + b · ID se ajustará a tus clics."))) f <- fitts_fit() div(class = "panel-soft", span(class = "eyebrow", tr("YOUR MODEL", "TU MODELO")), p(class = "model-eq", sprintf("MT = %.0f + %.0f · ID", f$a, f$b)), tags$ul(class = "footnote mb-0", tags$li(sprintf(tr("Each extra bit of difficulty costs you about %.0f ms.", "Cada bit extra de dificultad te cuesta unos %.0f ms."), f$b)), tags$li(sprintf(tr("R² = %.2f: the model explains %.0f%% of the variation in your times.", "R² = %.2f: el modelo explica el %.0f%% de la variación de tus tiempos."), f$r2, 100 * f$r2)), tags$li(sprintf(tr("Throughput ≈ %.1f bits/s · missed clicks: %d", "Rendimiento ≈ %.1f bits/s · clics fallidos: %d"), f$tp, as.integer(f$misses)))), p(class = "footnote mt-2 mb-0", tr("With only 18 trials the estimate is noisy; lab studies use hundreds per person.", "Con solo 18 intentos la estimación es ruidosa; los estudios de laboratorio usan cientos por persona."))) }) output$hick_plot <- renderPlot({ if (is.null(hick())) return(empty_plot(tr("Run the experiment to see your data", "Haz el experimento para ver tus datos"))) h <- hick_fit() means <- tapply(h$df$t, h$df$n, mean) ixd_par() plot(h$df$h, h$df$t, pch = 19, col = adjustcolor(ixd_green, .45), xlab = tr("log2(n + 1), n = number of options", "log2(n + 1), n = número de opciones"), ylab = tr("Decision time (ms)", "Tiempo de decisión (ms)"), xaxt = "n") axis(1, at = log2(c(2, 4, 8, 16) + 1), labels = paste0("n=", c(2, 4, 8, 16))) points(log2(as.numeric(names(means)) + 1), means, pch = 18, cex = 2.2, col = "#202522") abline(h$m, col = "#202522", lwd = 2) }, res = 96) output$hick_model <- renderUI({ if (is.null(hick())) return(div(class = "panel-soft footnote", tr("The model RT = a + b · log2(n + 1) will be fitted to your choices.", "El modelo RT = a + b · log2(n + 1) se ajustará a tus elecciones."))) h <- hick_fit() div(class = "panel-soft", span(class = "eyebrow", tr("YOUR MODEL", "TU MODELO")), p(class = "model-eq", sprintf("RT = %.0f + %.0f · log2(n + 1)", h$a, h$b)), tags$ul(class = "footnote mb-0", tags$li(sprintf(tr("Doubling the options adds about %.0f ms, not double the time.", "Duplicar las opciones añade unos %.0f ms, no el doble de tiempo."), h$b)), tags$li(sprintf(tr("R² = %.2f · wrong clicks: %d", "R² = %.2f · clics erróneos: %d"), h$r2, as.integer(h$errors)))), p(class = "footnote mt-2 mb-0", tr("Here you searched for a word, so part of the time is visual search, which grows more steeply than Hick's law predicts.", "Aquí buscabas una palabra, así que parte del tiempo es búsqueda visual, que crece más deprisa de lo que predice la ley de Hick."))) }) lines <- function() { c(if (!is.null(fitts())) { f <- fitts_fit(); sprintf(tr("Fitts: MT = %.0f + %.0f·ID ms, R² = %.2f, throughput %.1f bits/s, %d trials", "Fitts: MT = %.0f + %.0f·ID ms, R² = %.2f, rendimiento %.1f bits/s, %d intentos"), f$a, f$b, f$r2, f$tp, nrow(f$df)) } else tr("Fitts: not run", "Fitts: no realizado"), if (!is.null(hick())) { h <- hick_fit(); (nzchar(input$quote %||% "")) tags$blockquote(class = "persona-quote", paste0("“", input$quote, "”")), section(tr("GOALS", "OBJETIVOS"), input$goals), section(tr("FRUSTRATIONS", "FRUSTRACIONES"), content: # Research methods: choose a method that fits the research question, on the # attitudinal–behavioural and qualitative–quantitative landscape (after Rohrer, NN/g). research_methods <- data.frame( id = c("interviews", "contextual", "diary", "usability", "survey", "cardsort", "treetest", "analytics", "abtest", "focus"), name = c(tr("User interviews", "Entrevistas con usuarios"), tr("Contextual inquiry", "Indagación contextual"), tr("Diary study", "Estudio de diario"), tr("Usability test", "Test de usabilidad"), tr("Survey", "Encuesta"), tr("Card sorting", "Card sorting"), tr("Tree testing", "Tree testing"), tr("Analytics", "Analítica"), tr("A/B test", "Test A/B"), tr("Focus group", "Grupo focal")), x = c(.12, .62, .42, .78, .1, .32, .7, .95, .9, .06), y = c(.14, .2, .32, .26, .86, .55, .72, .95, .84, .06) ) research_scenarios <- list( enrol = list(text = tr("Students drop out of the online enrolment form at step 3. A few interviews first help you write good survey questions.", "«Cuántos» en una población grande es una pregunta cuantitativa y actitudinal: una encuesta con una muestra representativa. Unas pocas entrevistas antes ayudan a redactar buenas preguntas.")), button = list(text = tr("Decide which of two checkout button wordings leads to more completed purchases.", "Decidir cuál de dos textos del botón de pago lleva a más compras completadas."), best = c("abtest"), good = c("analytics"), why = tr("A causal question about behaviour at scale: a randomised A/B test with enough traffic (lab 14).", "Una pregunta causal sobre comportamiento a escala: un test A/B aleatorizado con tráfico suficiente (lab 14).")), nurses = list(text = tr("Understand how nurses plan their shifts across a whole week, at work and at home.", "Entender cómo planifican las enfermeras sus turnos a lo largo de una semana, en el trabajo y en casa."), best = c("diary", "contextual"), good = c("interviews"), why = tr("Behaviour that unfolds over days and in context: a diary study captures it over time, and contextual inquiry shows the real environment.", "Un comportamiento que se despliega durante días y en contexto: un estudio de diario lo recoge en el tiempo, y la indagación contextual muestra el entorno real.")), help = list(text = tr("Group 60 help articles for a new support centre in a way that makes sense to customers.", "Agrupar 60 artículos de ayuda de un nuevo centro de soporte de forma que tenga sentido para la clientela."), best = c("cardsort"), good = c("treetest", "interviews"), why = tr("Card sorting reveals how people group content; then tree-test the resulting structure.", "El card sorting revela cómo agrupa la gente el contenido; después, valida la estructura resultante con un tree test.")), menu = list(text = tr("Check whether people can find ‘Change payment method’ in a proposed menu, before any visual design exists.", "Comprobar si la gente encuentra «Cambiar método de pago» en un menú propuesto, antes de que exista el diseño visual."), best = c("treetest"), good = c("usability"), why = tr("Findability in a hierarchy without visual design is exactly what tree testing measures.", "La encontrabilidad en una jerarquía sin diseño visual es justo lo que mide el tree testing.")) ) research_methods_ui <- function(id) { ns <- NS(id) lab_section(ns, objectives = c(tr("Match a research question to a suitable method.", "Asociar una pregunta de investigación con un método adecuado."), tr("Place methods on the attitudinal–behavioural and qualitative–quantitative axes.", "Situar los métodos en los ejes actitudinal–conductual y cualitativo–cuantitativo."), tr("Write a short, defensible research plan.", "Redactar un plan de investigación breve y defendible.")), concept = tr("Start from the question, not the method. What people say (attitudes) and what they do (behaviour) often differ, and ‘why’ questions need qualitative methods while ‘how many’ questions need quantitative ones.", "Empieza por la pregunta, no por el método. Lo que la gente dice (actitudes) y lo que hace (comportamiento) a menudo difieren, y las preguntas «por qué» requieren métodos cualitativos mientras que las de «cuántos» requieren cuantitativos."), activity = tagList( p(tr("Challenge · For each research question, choose the method you would use first and say why.", "Reto · Para cada pregunta de investigación, elige el método que usarías primero y explica por qué.")), layout_columns(col_widths = c(6, 6), div( radioButtons(ns("scenario"), tr("Research question", "Pregunta de investigación"), width = "100%", setNames(names(research_scenarios), vapply(research_scenarios, `[[`, "", "text"))), selectInput(ns("method"), tr("Method you would use first", "Método que usarías primero"), setNames(research_methods$id, research_methods$name)), textAreaInput(ns("reason"), tr("Why this method? In what order would you run them, and why?", "¿Cuál de tus preguntas necesitaba más de un método? ¿En qué orden los aplicarías y por qué?")) } research_methods_server <- function(id) { moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) { plan <- reactiveVal(data.frame(question = character(), method = character(), fit = character(), n = integer(), reason = character())) feedback <- updateTextAreaInput(session, "reason", value = "") n_note <- if (input$method %in% c("survey", "abtest", "analytics") && isTRUE(input$participants < 100)) tr(" For a quantitative method, a handful of "interviews", "contextual", "diary") && isTRUE(input$participants > 30)) tr(" For a qualitative method, 5–12 participants per user group is usually enough; more adds cost but little new insight.", " ", "Encaje fuerte. "), good = tr("Useful, but not the best first step. ", "Útil, pero no el mejor primer paso. "), weak = tr("Weak fit. ", "Encaje débil. name: R/labs/mod_usability.R
content:
heuristics <- c(
  tr("Visibility of system status", "Visibilidad del estado del sistema"),
  tr("Match between system and the real world", "Relación entre el sistema y el mundo real"),
  tr("User control and freedom", "Control y libertad del usuario"),
  tr("Consistency and standards", "Consistencia y estándares"),
  tr("Error prevention", "Prevención de errores"),
  tr("Recognition rather than recall", "Reconocer mejor que recordar"),
  tr("Flexibility and efficiency of use", "Flexibilidad y eficiencia de uso"),
  tr("Aesthetic and minimalist design", "Diseño estético y minimalista"),
  tr("Help users recognise, diagnose, and recover from errors", "Ayudar a reconocer, diagnosticar y recuperarse de errores"),

severity_levels <- setNames(0:4, c(tr("0 · Not a problem", "0 · No es un problema"), tr("1 · Cosmetic", "1 · Estético"),
                                   tr("2 · Minor", "2 · Menor"), tr("3 · Major", "3 · Grave"), tr("4 · Catastrophe", "4 · Catastrófico")))

usability_scenarios <- list(
  booking = list(
    title = tr("Room booking form", "Formulario de reserva de sala"),
    what = tr("After pressing Book, the form clears itself. No message appears and no email arrives for several minutes.",
              "Al pulsar Reservar, el formulario se vacía. No aparece ningún mensaje y no llega ningún correo durante varios minutos."),
    likely = heuristics[c(1, 9)],

      tags$label(tr("Room", "Sala")), div(class = "form-control mb-2", tr("Group study room 3", "Sala de trabajo en grupo 3")),
      tags$label(tr("Date", "Fecha")), div(class = "form-control mb-3", "12/03"),

  search = list(

usability_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  lab_section(ns,
    objectives = c(tr("Inspect an interface against a usability heuristic.", "Inspeccionar una interfaz con una heurística de usabilidad."),
                   tr("Describe an observable issue rather than a preference.", "Describir un problema observable, no una preferencia."),
                   tr("Rate severity and suggest a testable change.", "Valorar la gravedad y proponer un cambio que se pueda probar.")),
    concept = tr("A heuristic evaluation is an expert review: it points to likely problems quickly and cheaply, but only testing with real users shows whether people actually struggle.",
                 "Una evaluación heurística es una revisión experta: señala problemas probables de forma rápida y barata, pero solo las pruebas con usuarios reales muestran si la gente tiene dificultades de verdad."),
    activity = tagList(
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(6, 6),
        div(
          radioButtons(ns("scenario"), tr("Interface to review", "Interfaz que revisar"), setNames(names(usability_scenarios), vapply(usability_scenarios, `[[`, "", "title"))),
          uiOutput(ns("mock")),
          uiOutput(ns("what"))),
        div(
          selectInput(ns("heuristic"), tr("Heuristic", "Heurística"), heuristics),
          selectInput(ns("severity"), tr("Severity", "Gravedad"), severity_levels, selected = 2),
          textAreaInput(ns("issue"), tr("Issue: what happens and who it affects", "Problema: qué ocurre y a quién afecta"), rows = 3, width = "100%"),
          textAreaInput(ns("fix"), tr("Recommendation: a change you could test", "Recomendación: un cambio que podrías probar"), rows = 2, width = "100%"),
          actionButton(ns("add"), tr("Add finding", "Añadir hallazgo"), class = "btn-primary"),
          uiOutput(ns("feedback")))),
      h4(class = "mt-4", tr("Findings", "Hallazgos")),
      tableOutput(ns("findings")),
      downloadButton(ns("export"), tr("Export findings report", "Exportar informe de hallazgos"), class = "btn-outline-success")),
    reflection = tr("Which part of your findings is evidence from the interface, and which part is your interpretation?",
                    "¿Qué parte de tus hallazgos es evidencia de la interfaz y qué parte es tu interpretación?"))
}

usability_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    findings <- reactiveVal(data.frame(interface = character(), heuristic = character(), severity = integer(), issue = character(), fix = character()))
    feedback <- reactiveVal(NULL)

    output$mock <- renderUI(usability_scenarios[[input$scenario]]$mock())
    output$what <- renderUI(p(class = "footnote mt-2", tags$strong(tr("What happens: ", "Qué ocurre: ")), usability_scenarios[[input$scenario]]$what))

    observeEvent(input$add, {
      issue <- trimws(input$issue); fix <- trimws(input$fix)
      if (nchar(issue) < 20 || nchar(fix) < 10) {
        return(feedback(div(class = "alert alert-warning mt-3", tr("Add a little more detail: describe the moment, its effect on the person, and one change.",
                                                                   "Añade algo más de detalle: describe el momento, su efecto en la persona y un cambio."))))
      }
      sc <- usability_scenarios[[input$scenario]]
      findings(rbind(findings(), data.frame(interface = sc$title, heuristic = input$heuristic, severity = as.integer(input$severity), issue = issue, fix = fix)))
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "issue", value = ""); updateTextAreaInput(session, "fix", value = "")
      feedback(if (input$heuristic %in% sc$likely) {
        div(class = "alert alert-success mt-3", tags$strong(tr("Finding added. ", "Hallazgo añadido. ")),
            tr("Reviewers often link this interface to ", "Los revisores suelen relacionar esta interfaz con "), tolower(input$heuristic), tr(" too.", " también."))
      } else {
        div(class = "alert alert-info mt-3", tags$strong(tr("Finding added. ", "Hallazgo añadido. ")),
            tr("Reviewers often link this interface to ", "Los revisores suelen relacionar esta interfaz con "), paste(tolower(sc$likely), collapse = tr(" or ", " o ")),
            tr(". Your choice can still be valid: does your note explain the connection?", ". Tu elección puede ser válida igualmente: ¿explica tu nota la relación?"))
      })
    })
    output$feedback <- renderUI(feedback())

    output$findings <- renderTable({
      x <- findings()
      if (!nrow(x)) return(setNames(data.frame(tr("No findings yet.", "Todavía no hay hallazgos.")), " "))
      x <- x[order(-x$severity), ]
      setNames(x, c(tr("Interface", "Interfaz"), tr("Heuristic", "Heurística"), tr("Severity", "Gravedad"), tr("Issue", "Problema"), tr("Recommendation", "Recomendación")))
    }, striped = TRUE, width = "100%")

    report <- function() {
      x <- findings()
      if (!nrow(x)) return(tr("(no findings)", "(sin hallazgos)"))
      x <- x[order(-x$severity), ]
      unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(x)), function(i) c(sprintf(tr("%d. [Severity %d] %s · %s", "%d. [Gravedad %d] %s · %s"), i, x$severity[i], x$interface[i], x$heuristic[i]),
                                                    paste(tr("   Issue:", "   Problema:"), x$issue[i]), paste(tr("   Recommendation:", "   Recomendación:"), x$fix[i]))))
    }
    output$export <- downloadHandler(filename = function() "ixd-usability-findings.txt",
      content = function(file) writeLines(enc2utf8(c(tr("IxD Lab · Heuristic evaluation findings", "IxD Lab · Hallazgos de la evaluación heurística"), format(Sys.Date()), "", report())), file, useBytes = TRUE))
    observeEvent(input$example, {
      findings(data.frame(
        interface = c(usability_scenarios$booking$title, usability_scenarios$search$title),
        heuristic = heuristics[c(1, 2)], severity = c(3L, 2L),
        issue = c(tr("After booking, the form clears with no message, so people do not know whether the room is booked and may book twice.",
                     "Tras reservar, el formulario se vacía sin mensaje, así que la gente no sabe si la sala está reservada y puede reservar dos veces."),
                  tr("The empty search result uses system jargon and offers no way forward.", "El resultado vacío usa jerga técnica y no ofrece cómo seguir.")),
        fix = c(tr("Show a confirmation with the room, date and a link to cancel.", "Mostrar una confirmación con la sala, la fecha y un enlace para cancelar."),
                tr("Explain that nothing matched and suggest related courses.", "Explicar que no hay coincidencias y sugerir cursos relacionados."))))
      example_reflection(session, tr(
        "The booking problem is observable: the form clears and nothing appears. That people book twice is my interpretation; I would check it with a quick usability test.",
        "El problema de la reserva es observable: el formulario se vacía y no aparece nada. Que la gente reserve dos veces es mi interpretación; lo comprobaría con un test de usabilidad rápido."))
    })

    reflect_server(tr("Usability", "Usabilidad"), input, output, session, report)
  })
}

name: R/labs/mod_user_behaviour.R
content:
behaviour_traces <- list(
  search = list(title = tr("Course search", "Búsqueda de cursos"), steps = data.frame(
    page = c(tr("Home", "Inicio"), tr("Search", "Buscar"), tr("Results", "Resultados"), tr("Search", "Buscar"), tr("Results", "Resultados"), tr("Course detail", "Ficha del curso")),
    seconds = c(3, 8, 14, 6, 22, 25),
    kind = c("view", "view", "view", "back", "view", "view"))),
  registration = list(title = tr("Event registration", "Inscripción a un evento"), steps = data.frame(
    page = c(tr("Event page", "Página del evento"), tr("Registration form", "Formulario"), tr("Help: payment", "Ayuda: pago"), tr("Registration form", "Formulario"), tr("Confirmation", "Confirmación")),
    seconds = c(4, 11, 17, 31, 3),
    kind = c("view", "view", "help", "view", "view"))),
  library = list(title = tr("Library checkout", "Préstamo en la biblioteca"), steps = data.frame(
    page = c(tr("Catalogue", "Catálogo"), tr("Book detail", "Ficha del libro"), tr("Sign in", "Iniciar sesión"), tr("Book detail", "Ficha del libro"), tr("Sign in", "Iniciar sesión"), tr("Reserve", "Reservar"), tr("Reserve", "Reservar")),
    seconds = c(9, 12, 20, 5, 28, 15, 4),
    kind = c("view", "view", "view", "back", "view", "view", "view")))
)

methods_choices <- c(tr("Think-aloud usability test", "Test de usabilidad con pensamiento en voz alta"), tr("Short follow-up interview", "Entrevista breve posterior"),
                     tr("Consented, anonymised analytics", "Analítica anonimizada y con consentimiento"), tr("Survey with open questions", "Encuesta con preguntas abiertas"),
                     tr("A/B test of a redesigned step", "Test A/B de un paso rediseñado"))

user_behaviour_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  lab_section(ns,
    objectives = c(tr("Read an interaction sequence.", "Leer una secuencia de interacción."),
                   tr("Separate observations from explanations.", "Separar observaciones de explicaciones."),
                   tr("Plan how to collect evidence ethically.", "Planificar cómo recoger evidencia de forma ética.")),
    concept = tr("A log shows what happened, never why. A long pause could be confusion, careful reading, or a phone call. Explanations become evidence only when you test them with people.",
                 "Un registro muestra qué pasó, nunca por qué. Una pausa larga puede ser confusión, lectura atenta o una llamada de teléfono. Las explicaciones solo se convierten en evidencia cuando las pruebas con personas."),
    activity = tagList(
      div(class = "alert alert-warning", tags$strong(tr("SIMULATED DATA · ", "DATOS SIMULADOS · ")),
          tr("Illustrative traces written for this exercise; no participants were observed.", "Recorridos ilustrativos escritos para este ejercicio; no se ha observado a ningún participante.")),
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(4, 8),
        div(
          radioButtons(ns("scenario"), tr("Scenario", "Escenario"), setNames(names(behaviour_traces), vapply(behaviour_traces, `[[`, "", "title"))),
          div(class = "panel-soft", span(class = "eyebrow", tr("SUMMARY", "RESUMEN")), uiOutput(ns("summary")))),
        div(
          uiOutput(ns("trace")),
          div(class = "legend mt-2", span(tags$i(style = "background:#276b5b;opacity:.75"), tr("Page view", "Visita a página")),
              span(tags$i(style = "background:#a35b4f"), tr("Went back", "Volvió atrás")), span(tags$i(style = "background:#d4a15e"), tr("Opened help", "Abrió la ayuda"))))),
      hr(),
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(6, 6),
        textAreaInput(ns("observation"), tr("What I observe (only what the trace shows)", "Lo que observo (solo lo que muestra el recorrido)"), rows = 3, width = "100%",
                      placeholder = tr("e.g. The person returned to Search after 14 seconds on Results.", "p. ej. La persona volvió a Buscar tras 14 segundos en Resultados.")),
        textAreaInput(ns("explanation"), tr("Possible explanations (at least two)", "Posibles explicaciones (al menos dos)"), rows = 3, width = "100%",
                      placeholder = tr("e.g. The results did not match the query; or the person refined it on purpose.", "p. ej. Los resultados no encajaban con la búsqueda; o la persona la afinó a propósito."))),
      checkboxGroupInput(ns("methods"), tr("How would you test your explanations?", "¿Cómo pondrías a prueba tus explicaciones?"), methods_choices),
      uiOutput(ns("method_feedback"))),
    reflection = tr("What alternative explanation could account for the longest pause? What would you need consent for?",
                    "¿Qué explicación alternativa podría justificar la pausa más larga? ¿Para qué necesitarías consentimiento?"))
}

user_behaviour_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    trace <- reactive(behaviour_traces[[input$scenario]]$steps)

    output$trace <- renderUI({
      x <- trace()
      longest <- max(x$seconds)
      tagList(lapply(seq_len(nrow(x)), function(i) div(class = "trace-row",
        span(paste0(i, ". ", x$page[i])),
        div(class = paste("trace-bar", x$kind[i]), style = sprintf("width:%.0f%%", 100 * x$seconds[i] / longest),
            role = "img", `aria-label` = sprintf(tr("%s, %d seconds", "%s, %d segundos"), x$page[i], x$seconds[i])),
        span(class = "footnote", paste(x$seconds[i], "s")))))
    })

    output$summary <- renderUI({
      x <- trace()
      tags$ul(class = "check-list footnote",
        tags$li(sprintf(tr("%d steps · %d s in total", "%d pasos · %d s en total"), nrow(x), sum(x$seconds))),
        tags$li(sprintf(tr("Longest step: %s (%d s)", "Paso más largo: %s (%d s)"), x$page[which.max(x$seconds)], max(x$seconds))),
        tags$li(sprintf(tr("Went back: %d · Opened help: %d", "Volvió atrás: %d · Abrió la ayuda: %d"), sum(x$kind == "back"), sum(x$kind == "help"))),
        tags$li(tr("Durations are illustrative, not measured.", "Las duraciones son ilustrativas, no medidas.")))
    })

    output$method_feedback <- renderUI({
      m <- input$methods
      req(length(m))
      notes <- c(
        if (methods_choices[1] %in% m) tr("Think-aloud shows why people pause, but needs informed consent and recording rules.", "Pensar en voz alta muestra por qué se detiene la gente, pero requiere consentimiento informado y normas de grabación."),
        if (methods_choices[3] %in% m) tr("Analytics tell you how often a pattern happens, not why; collect only the fields your question needs.", "La analítica dice con qué frecuencia ocurre algo, no por qué; recoge solo los campos que necesita tu pregunta."),
        if (methods_choices[5] %in% m) tr("An A/B test compares outcomes, but needs enough participants and a clear success measure.", "Un test A/B compara resultados, pero necesita suficientes participantes y una medida de éxito clara."),
        if (length(m) == 1) tr("Combining a behavioural method with one that asks people directly makes your explanation stronger.", "Combinar un método conductual con otro que pregunte directamente a las personas refuerza tu explicación."))
      req(length(notes))
      div(class = "alert alert-info mt-2", tags$ul(class = "mb-0", lapply(notes, tags$li)))
    })

    observeEvent(input$example, {
      updateRadioButtons(session, "scenario", selected = "registration")
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "observation", value = tr(
        "The person opened the payment help after 11 seconds on the form, then spent 31 seconds on the form before confirming.",
        "La persona abrió la ayuda de pago tras 11 segundos en el formulario y luego pasó 31 segundos en él antes de confirmar."))
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "explanation", value = tr(
        "The payment options may be unclear; or the person was looking for a discount; or they paused to find their card.",
        "Las opciones de pago pueden no estar claras; o buscaba un descuento; o se detuvo a buscar la tarjeta."))
      updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "methods", selected = methods_choices[c(1, 2)])
      example_reflection(session, tr(
        "The trace shows where time went, not why. A think-aloud test with consent would tell me whether the payment step confused people.",
        "El recorrido muestra dónde se fue el tiempo, no por qué. Un test de pensamiento en voz alta con consentimiento me diría si el paso de pago confundió a la gente."))
    })

    reflect_server(tr("User behaviour", "Comportamiento del usuario"), input, output, session, function() c(
      paste(tr("Scenario (simulated):", "Escenario (simulado):"), behaviour_traces[[input$scenario]]$title),
      paste(tr("Observation:", "Observación:"), trimws(input$observation %||% "")),
      paste(tr("Explanations:", "Explicaciones:"), trimws(input$explanation %||% "")),
      paste(tr("Methods:", "Métodos:"), if (length(input$methods)) paste(input$methods, collapse = "; ") else tr("(none)", "(ninguno)"))))
  })
}

(1 - conf) / 2) p <- (x + z^2 / 2) / (n + z^2) se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / (n + z^2)) c(max(0, p - z * se), min(1, p + z * se)) } metrics_study <- local({ set.seed(42) tasks <- c(tr("Find this week's reading", "Encontrar la lectura de la semana"), tr("Submit an assignment", "Entregar un trabajo"), tr("Book office hours", "Reservar una tutoría")) p_success <- c(.9, .7, .4); mean_time <- c(55, 120, 210) d <- expand.grid(participant = paste0("P", 1:10), task = tasks, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) d$success <- rbinom(nrow(d), 1, rep(p_success, each = 10)) d$time <- round(exp(rnorm(nrow(d), log(rep(mean_time, each = 10)), .45))) d$errors <- rpois(nrow(d), rep(c(.3, 1, 2), each = 10)) list(tasks = tasks, data = d, sus = round(pmin(100, pmax(20, rnorm(10, 66, 14))) / 2.5) * 2.5) }) ux_metrics_ui <- function(id) { ns <- NS(id) lab_section(ns, objectives = c(tr("Score the System Usability Scale and interpret it against benchmarks.", "Puntuar la System Usability Scale e interpretarla con valores de referencia."), tr("Report task success and time with confidence intervals.", "Presentar el éxito y el tiempo en las tareas con intervalos de confianza."), tr("Decide how many participants a test needs.", "Decidir cuántos participantes necesita un test.")), concept = tr("Usability (ISO 9241-11) is effectiveness, efficiency and satisfaction in a context of use. ", sus_items[i]), choices = 1:5, selected = 3, inline = TRUE, width = "100%"))), uiOutput(ns("sus_result"))))), nav_panel(tr("2 · Analyse a study", "2 · Analiza un estudio"), div(class = "pt-3", simulated_note(), p(tr("Ten participants tried three tasks on a learning platform. cuenta."), text = tr("Password must comply with the security policy.", "La contraseña debe cumplir la política de seguridad.")) ) count_syllables <- function(word) { w <- tolower(gsub("[^[:alpha:]]", "", word)) if (!nzchar(w)) return(0) if (identical(LANG, "es")) return(max(1, lengths(regmatches(w, gregexpr("[aeiouáéíóúü]+", w))))) w <- sub("(?:[^laeiouy]es|ed|[^laeiouy]e)$", "", w, perl = TRUE) max(1, lengths(regmatches(w, gregexpr("[aeiouy]+", w)))) } # Flesch reading ease (English) or Fernández-Huerta (Spanish): higher is easier, 60–80 is plain language. readability <- function(text) { words <- regmatches(text, gregexpr("[[:alpha:]áéíóúüñÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ']+", text))[[1]] if (!length(words)) return(list(words = 0, ease = NA_real_)) sentences <- max(1, lengths(regmatches(text, gregexpr("[.!?]+", text)))) syl <- sum(vapply(words, count_syllables, 1)) n <- length(words) ease <- if (identical(LANG, "es")) 206.84 - 0.60 * (100 * syl / n) - 1.02 * (100 * sentences / n) else 206.835 - 1.015 * (n / sentences) - 84.6 * (syl / n) list(words = n, ease = round(max(0, min(100, ease)))) } writing_checks <- function(text, type) { x <- tolower(text) has <- function(words) any(vapply(words, function(w) grepl(paste0("\\b", w, "\\b"), x, perl = TRUE), TRUE)) n <- readability(text)$words out <- list( list(ok = !has(tr(c("invalid", "illegal", "wrong", "failed", "error", text = tr("Specific action, not a generic label (OK, Submit, Yes)", "Acción concreta, no una etiqueta genérica (Aceptar, Enviar, Sí)"))), empty = list(list(ok = n >= 6, text = tr("Explains why it is text = tr("Names the consequence and the action instead of ‘Are you sure? name: R/labs/mod_wireframing.R
content:
wire_components <- c(
  nav = tr("Navigation", "Navegación"), heading = tr("Page heading", "Título de página"), search = tr("Search field", "Campo de búsqueda"),
  text = tr("Body text", "Texto"), image = tr("Image placeholder", "Imagen"), cards = tr("Card list", "Lista de tarjetas"),
  field = tr("Form field", "Campo de formulario"), button = tr("Primary button", "Botón principal"), footer = tr("Footer", "Pie de página")
)

wire_templates <- setNames(list(
  c("nav", "heading", "text", "search", "cards", "button", "footer"),
  c("nav", "heading", "image", "text", "field", "field", "button", "footer")
), c(tr("Course finder", "Buscador de cursos"), tr("Event sign-up", "Inscripción a un evento")))

# Low-fidelity drawing of one component on the canvas.
wire_sketch <- function(key) {
  bar <- function(width = "100%") div(class = "wf-bar", style = paste0("width:", width))
  body <- switch(key,
    nav = div(class = "wf-row", bar(), bar(), bar(), bar()),
    heading = bar("70%"),
    search = div(class = "wf-field"),
    text = tagList(bar(), bar("92%"), bar("60%")),
    image = div(class = "wf-image"),
    cards = div(class = "wf-row", div(class = "wf-card"), div(class = "wf-card"), div(class = "wf-card")),
    field = tagList(bar("30%"), div(class = "wf-field")),
    button = div(class = "wf-button"),
    footer = tagList(bar("80%"), bar("50%")))
  cls <- c(nav = "wf-nav", heading = "wf-heading", cards = "wf-cards", footer = "wf-footer")[key]
  div(class = paste("wf", if (is.na(cls)) "" else cls), span(class = "wf-label", wire_components[[key]]), body)
}

# Formative checks on the current sketch.
wire_checks <- function(items, screen) {
  n_button <- sum(items == "button")
  long_mobile <- screen == "mobile" && length(items) > 7
  list(
    list(ok = "heading" %in% items, text = tr("A page heading tells visitors where they are.", "Un título de página indica dónde se encuentra la persona.")),
    list(ok = n_button == 1, text = if (n_button > 1) tr("More than one primary button competes for attention.", "Más de un botón principal compite por la atención.")
                                    else tr("One primary button makes the next step clear.", "Un único botón principal deja claro el siguiente paso.")),
    list(ok = length(items) > 0 && items[1] == "nav", text = tr("Navigation sits at the top, where people expect it.", "La navegación está arriba, donde la gente la espera.")),
    list(ok = length(items) > 0 && items[length(items)] == "footer", text = tr("A footer closes the page with secondary links.", "Un pie de página cierra la página con enlaces secundarios.")),
    list(ok = !long_mobile, text = if (long_mobile) tr("On mobile, this many blocks means a long scroll: what could you remove?", "En móvil, tantos bloques suponen mucho scroll: ¿qué podrías quitar?")
                                   else tr("The page length suits this screen width.", "La longitud de la página encaja con este ancho de pantalla."))
  )
}

wireframing_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  lab_section(ns,
    objectives = c(tr("Build a simple page hierarchy.", "Construir una jerarquía de página sencilla."),
                   tr("Compare component choices and their order.", "Comparar componentes y su orden."),
                   tr("Explain how a layout supports one task.", "Explicar cómo una maquetación apoya una tarea.")),
    concept = tr("A wireframe shows structure and priority, not visual style. Keep it grey and rough so discussion stays on what the page must do and in which order.",
                 "Un wireframe muestra estructura y prioridad, no estilo visual. Mantenlo gris y esquemático para que la conversación se centre en qué debe hacer la página y en qué orden."),
    activity = tagList(
      p(tr("Challenge · Sketch a landing page that helps a new student find a course.", "Reto · Boceta una página de inicio que ayude a un estudiante nuevo a encontrar un curso.")),
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(4, 8),
        div(
          selectInput(ns("component"), tr("Component", "Componente"), setNames(names(wire_components), wire_components)),
          actionButton(ns("add"), tr("Add to canvas", "Añadir al lienzo"), class = "btn-primary w-100 mb-3"),
          selectInput(ns("template"), tr("Or start from a template", "O empieza con una plantilla"), c(setNames("", tr("Choose a template", "Elige una plantilla")), names(wire_templates))),
          radioButtons(ns("screen"), tr("Canvas width", "Ancho del lienzo"), setNames(c("desktop", "tablet", "mobile"), c(tr("Desktop", "Escritorio"), "Tablet", tr("Mobile", "Móvil"))), inline = TRUE),
          actionButton(ns("clear"), tr("Clear canvas", "Vaciar lienzo"), class = "btn-outline-secondary w-100 mb-2"),
          downloadButton(ns("export"), tr("Export sketch", "Exportar boceto"), class = "btn-outline-success w-100"),
          div(class = "panel-soft mt-3", span(class = "eyebrow", tr("DESIGN CHECKS", "COMPROBACIONES")), uiOutput(ns("checks")))),
        uiOutput(ns("canvas")))),
    reflection = tr("Which element establishes the clearest next step? What would you change for a narrow screen?",
                    "¿Qué elemento marca el siguiente paso con más claridad? ¿Qué cambiarías para una pantalla estrecha?"))
}

wireframing_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    items <- reactiveVal(character())
    observeEvent(input$add, items(c(items(), input$component)))
    observeEvent(input$clear, items(character()))
    observeEvent(input$template, {
      req(nzchar(input$template))
      items(wire_templates[[input$template]])
      updateSelectInput(session, "template", selected = "")
    })
    observeEvent(input$item_action, {
      x <- items(); i <- input$item_action$i
      req(i >= 1, i <= length(x))
      j <- switch(input$item_action$action, up = i - 1, down = i + 1, NA)
      if (input$item_action$action == "remove") x <- x[-i]
      else if (!is.na(j) && j >= 1 && j <= length(x)) x[c(i, j)] <- x[c(j, i)]
      items(x)
    })

    output$canvas <- renderUI({
      x <- items()
      width <- switch(input$screen %||% "desktop", desktop = "100%", tablet = "560px", mobile = "320px")
      tool <- function(action, i, label, icon) {
        tags$button(class = "btn btn-outline-secondary", type = "button", `aria-label` = paste(label, wire_components[[x[i]]]), title = label,
                    onclick = js_event(session$ns("item_action"), sprintf("{action: '%s', i: %d}", action, i)), icon)
      }
      div(class = "wire-canvas", style = paste0("max-width:", width), `aria-label` = tr("Wireframe canvas", "Lienzo del wireframe"),
        if (!length(x)) p(class = "muted m-2", tr("Your canvas is empty. Add a component or start from a template.", "Tu lienzo está vacío. Añade un componente o empieza con una plantilla."))
        else lapply(seq_along(x), function(i) div(class = "wire-item", wire_sketch(x[i]),
          div(class = "wire-tools", tool("up", i, tr("Move up", "Subir"), "↑"), tool("down", i, tr("Move down", "Bajar"), "↓"), tool("remove", i, tr("Remove", "Quitar"), "×")))))
    })

    output$checks <- renderUI({
      if (!length(items())) return(p(class = "footnote mb-0", tr("Checks appear when you add components.", "Las comprobaciones aparecen al añadir componentes.")))
      tags$ul(class = "check-list footnote", lapply(wire_checks(items(), input$screen), function(ch) tags$li(class = if (ch$ok) "ok" else "todo", ch$text)))
    })

    sketch_lines <- function() {
      x <- items()
      c(paste0(tr("Canvas: ", "Lienzo: "), input$screen), if (length(x)) paste(seq_along(x), unname(wire_components[x]), sep = ". ") else tr("(empty)", "(vacío)"), "",
        tr("Design checks:", "Comprobaciones:"), vapply(wire_checks(x, input$screen), function(ch) paste(if (ch$ok) "[ok]" else tr("[review]", "[revisar]"), ch$text), ""))
    }
    output$export <- downloadHandler(filename = function() "ixd-wireframe.txt",
      content = function(file) writeLines(enc2utf8(c(tr("IxD Lab · Wireframing sketch", "IxD Lab · Boceto de wireframing"), "", sketch_lines())), file, useBytes = TRUE))
    observeEvent(input$example, {
      items(wire_templates[[1]])
      updateRadioButtons(session, "screen", selected = "mobile")
      example_reflection(session, tr(
        "The search field and the course cards make the next step clear. On mobile the page gets long: I would drop the body text and test whether students still find a course.",
        "El campo de búsqueda y las tarjetas de cursos dejan claro el siguiente paso. En móvil la página se alarga: quitaría el texto y probaría si los estudiantes siguen encontrando un curso."))
    })

    reflect_server("Wireframing", input, output, session, sketch_lines)
  })
}
